message.content: {"caption":"Five-panel grouped bar chart comparing F1 and BLEU-1 scores across k values for five task types.","description":"The target is a five-panel grouped vertical bar chart. In every panel, the horizontal axis is labeled “k values” and has categories 10, 20, 30, 40, and 50. The legend identifies blue bars as F1 and orange bars as BLEU-1; no y-axis title is shown. Panel labels are (a) Multi Hop, (b) Temporal, (c) Open Domain, (d) Single Hop, and (e) Adversarial. The y-axis tick scales differ by panel: Multi Hop is marked from 12.5 to 27.5, Temporal from 35 to 47.5, Open Domain from 6 to 14, Single Hop at 25, 30, 35, 40, and 45, and Adversarial at 30, 35, 40, 45, and 50. F1 is higher than BLEU-1 at all plotted categories. In Multi Hop, both series rise from k=10 and then mostly level off; in Temporal, both rise modestly and peak around k=40 before dipping at k=50; in Open Domain, both rise overall but fluctuate, with a larger increase at k=50; in Single Hop, both increase steadily; and in Adversarial, both rise to a peak at k=40 and fall at k=50.
